name: Fix shop gallery arrow scrolling
on:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/fix-shop-gallery-arrows.yml'

jobs:
  fix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Make shop gallery arrows move one photo at a time
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re

          p = Path('script.js')
          s = p.read_text()

          old = """      const prev = controls.querySelector('.shop-gallery-prev');
      const next = controls.querySelector('.shop-gallery-next');
      const amount = () => Math.max(gallery.clientWidth * 0.78, 260);
      prev.addEventListener('click', () => gallery.scrollBy({ left: -amount(), behavior: 'smooth' }));
      next.addEventListener('click', () => gallery.scrollBy({ left: amount(), behavior: 'smooth' }));
      const updateArrows = () => {
        const max = Math.max(0, gallery.scrollWidth - gallery.clientWidth);
        prev.disabled = gallery.scrollLeft <= 4;
        next.disabled = gallery.scrollLeft >= max - 4;
      };
"""

          new = """      const prev = controls.querySelector('.shop-gallery-prev');
      const next = controls.querySelector('.shop-gallery-next');
      const figures = () => [...gallery.querySelectorAll('figure')];
      const positions = () => {
        const galleryRect = gallery.getBoundingClientRect();
        return figures().map(figure => figure.getBoundingClientRect().left - galleryRect.left + gallery.scrollLeft);
      };
      const nearestIndex = () => {
        const xs = positions();
        if (!xs.length) return 0;
        return xs.reduce((best, x, index) =>
          Math.abs(x - gallery.scrollLeft) < Math.abs(xs[best] - gallery.scrollLeft) ? index : best, 0);
      };
      const scrollToIndex = index => {
        const xs = positions();
        if (!xs.length) return;
        const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, xs.length - 1));
        gallery.scrollTo({ left: xs[target], behavior: 'smooth' });
      };
      prev.addEventListener('click', event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        scrollToIndex(nearestIndex() - 1);
      });
      next.addEventListener('click', event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        scrollToIndex(nearestIndex() + 1);
      });
      const updateArrows = () => {
        const index = nearestIndex();
        const last = Math.max(0, figures().length - 1);
        prev.disabled = index <= 0 && gallery.scrollLeft <= 4;
        next.disabled = index >= last || gallery.scrollLeft >= gallery.scrollWidth - gallery.clientWidth - 4;
      };
"""

          if old not in s:
              raise SystemExit('Expected shop gallery arrow block was not found; refusing to make an unsafe edit.')
          s = s.replace(old, new, 1)

          old_style = ".shop-gallery-arrow-wrap{position:relative}.shop-gallery-arrows{position:absolute;"
          new_style = ".shop-gallery-arrow-wrap{position:relative}.shop-gallery-scroll{scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scroll-behavior:smooth}.shop-gallery-scroll>figure{scroll-snap-align:start;scroll-snap-stop:always}.shop-gallery-arrows{position:absolute;"
          if old_style not in s:
              raise SystemExit('Expected shop gallery style block was not found; refusing to make an unsafe edit.')
          s = s.replace(old_style, new_style, 1)
          p.write_text(s)

          index = Path('index.html')
          html = index.read_text()
          html = re.sub(r'script\.js\?v=[^"\']+', 'script.js?v=20261002-0005', html, count=1)
          index.write_text(html)
          PY

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add script.js index.html
          git commit -m "Fix shop gallery arrow scrolling" || exit 0
          git push
